reason: I already paid for a job-tracking app and my boys dropped it in a few weeks, so we went back to calls and WhatsApp. The price is nothing for me, but I am not putting my team through another app in the middle of the summer rush.
objection: My technicians will press the button for one week and then stop, and I will be back to chasing them on the phone. Free trial or not, the time lost getting them to use it is my cost.
would_change_my_mind: If another Chennai firm my size shows me their technicians still using it after three months and the AMC reminders actually bringing renewals, and you set it up after the summer season, I would try it.
